items.originalTitle: Why Daniel Ricciardo is staying away from the F1 paddock
items.summaryEn: Daniel Ricciardo has explained why he has been staying away from the Formula 1 paddock. His F1 career ended after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix, when RB replaced him with Liam Lawson.
detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多解释了自己为何一直远离F1围场。
里卡多的F1生涯结束后，他便退出了公众视野。以下是他为何不确定自己是否还想回来的原因。
一名车迷举着丹尼尔·里卡多的标语牌。
丹尼尔·里卡多详细讲述了自己一直远离F1围场的原因。
里卡多的F1生涯在2024年新加坡大奖赛之后结束，当时这位小红牛车手在经历了一个艰难的赛季后被利亚姆·劳森取代。
过去两年里，这位澳大利亚人远离了聚光灯，更多时间待在家里，更少乘坐飞机，不过他确实成为了福特赛车的全球大使。
并非所有前F1车手在停止参加世界锦标赛后都保持不活跃。其中一些人在其他系列赛中比赛；在2025年和2026年，罗伯特·库比卡、小林可梦伟和尼克·德弗里斯赢得了勒芒24小时耐力赛。
其他人则成为电视评论员，比如简森·巴顿、大卫·库特哈德、海基·科瓦莱宁、尼科·罗斯伯格和雅克·维伦纽夫等众多人士。
里卡多尚未涉足这些，当在《Beyond The Grid》播客中被问及我们是否会以某种身份看到他重返F1围场时，这位八次大奖赛冠军得主回应道：“我不确定。
“如果你一年前问我，我会说‘不，我再也不想只是待在周围了’。那时，我感受到很多痛苦，所以待在周围会带来太多痛苦。我对此非常消极。
“但我觉得过去几年我也试着理解我的自尊心。当所有这些事情发生并在你面前崩塌时，会有一些感觉，我猜，像是自尊心的死亡。然后我想，为什么我这么反对？好吧，那也是我的自尊心在说话，‘哦，我永远不会回到围场，我不想见那些人’，那大概也是我的自尊心在试图保护我自己。
“我现在处于一个非常感激F1给予我的许多东西以及那些关系的位置；我仍然和很多车手、工程师、机械师交谈——有些关系我仍然保持着。甚至新加坡[2024]，比赛后那晚我在赛道待得很晚，因为我知道，我当时想，我不知道什么时候会回来。所以我尽量多地道别，但非常伤感，只是可能不是我想和某些人道别的方式。”

“所以我确实想回去，但让我纠结的是，如果我回去得太早，会不会就变成‘嘿，丹尼尔，他是不是要回来了，他在干什么？’我不想背负那种媒体包袱，我只想去见见一些朋友，但我也明白F1围场不是那样的，运作方式也不是那样——这一点我理解。这也是我一直没回去的原因之一，因为我不想要那种关注，我觉得如果我没有明确目的就走进围场，那就会变成‘好吧，丹尼尔为什么在这儿，他是不是就为了拍张照片？’这些只是我对自己说的话，”他笑着说。
“我真的不想到处奔波。一想到F1的赛历我就发怵，所以这就是我的想法，我觉得那里没有什么是我会……”
“我跟几个朋友聊过，他们在其他运动项目里，现在是退役运动员，但以管理者、车队老板的身份回到了这项运动，或者担任了某个角色。说来有趣。其中一位特别说过，‘这并不比我参赛时轻松’，因为你仍然投入得那么深——尤其是对运动员——他们的问题就是你的问题，而且你下班回家也摆脱不了。你仍然背负着一名运动员的重量。”
“我确实喜欢和年轻车手交流，我确实喜欢尝试分享我的一些知识和经验。我只是觉得我不想再经历所有这些情绪了——那太沉重了。想到能脱离那些，活得更轻松、更自由一点，那感觉就是更好、更舒服。”
“我不认为那能帮助我成为最好的自己，尤其是在对我重要的人身边。”
这位珀斯本地人一直在电视上看比赛，他的父亲很欣赏他的见解。那么他是否愿意有朝一日当评论员呢？“还有出差奔波呢！”里卡多惊呼道。
丹尼尔·里卡多、格蕾丝·里卡多、乔·里卡多
“这很难，因为很多人对我说，‘哦，你在电视上会很出色’。你看，我内心有一部分觉得，是的，能分享我的许多经验和知识会很棒。即使我和我爸爸一起看比赛，我爸爸也会说，‘天哪，得有人听听你在比赛期间说的话，因为我看比赛时从你那里学到了很多’。显然那只是因为我是那20名车手之一。我想，我们中有少数人真正体验过那种水平。显然我很感激很多前车手现在从事那个领域，这是有原因的。
“人生中做些完全不同的事情，也有一种令人耳目一新的感觉。也许能以某种方式活出两段人生，光是这个想法就挺美好的。也许就是合上那本书、继续前行，听起来也很酷。但有时候我又会想，我拥有35年的赛车智慧和知识；就这样把它锁进盒子里，再也不让人看到或听到，这算不算一种浪费？
“我不知道。我想这就是为什么我还没有真正投入任何事情，因为我在努力确保我所做的是对的。”
detailEn: Why Daniel Ricciardo is staying away from the F1 paddock
Ricciardo stepped away from the limelight when his F1 career ended. Here’s why he’s unsure he even wants to come back
A fan holds up a sign of Daniel Ricciardo
Daniel Ricciardo has delved into the reasons why he has been staying away from the Formula 1 paddock.
Ricciardo’s F1 career ended after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix, when the RB driver was replaced by Liam Lawson after enduring a tough campaign thus far.
In the past two years, the Australian has stayed away from the limelight, spending more time at home and less on planes, though he did become a global ambassador for Ford Racing.

Not all former F1 drivers stay inactive when they stop competing in the world championship. Some of them race in other series; across 2025 and 2026, Robert Kubica, Kamui Kobayashi and Nyck de Vries won the Le Mans 24 Hours.
Others become TV pundits, like Jenson Button, David Coulthard, Heikki Kovalainen, Nico Rosberg and Jacques Villeneuve among many others.

Ricciardo has engaged in none of this yet, and when asked in the Beyond The Grid podcast if we would see him back in the F1 paddock in some capacity, the eight-time grand prix winner responded: “I’m not sure.

“If you would have asked me a year ago, I would have said ‘No, I don’t ever want to just be around anymore’. At that time, I felt a lot of pain, so it caused too much pain to be around. I was very negative towards it.

“But I think also the last couple of years I’ve tried to understand my ego. There were some feelings of, I guess, like an ego death, when all of these things happen and kind of collapse in front of you. Then I was like, why am I so anti? Okay, that’s my ego also talking, ‘Oh, I’m never going to come back to the paddock, I don’t want to see any of those people’, and that’s also probably my ego trying to protect myself.

“I’m at a place now where I’m very appreciative of many of the things that F1 gave me and the relationships too; I still speak to a lot of the drivers, engineers, mechanics – there’s relationships that I still have. Even Singapore [2024], I stayed at the track quite late that night after the race, because I knew, I was like, I don’t know when I’m going to be back. So I tried to say as many goodbyes as I could, but it was very sombre, just not the way I probably want to say goodbye to some people.

“So I do want to, but I think the thing I’ve been torn with is if I go back too soon, is it just going to be like, ‘Hey, Daniel, is he coming back, what is he doing?’. I don’t want the kind of media baggage with that, I just want to be able to go and see some friends, but I also appreciate that’s not the reality of an F1 paddock and how it works – and I understand that. It’s kind of why I haven’t come back as well, because I don’t want the attention, and I think if I go into the paddock without a purpose, it’s like, ‘Okay, why is Daniel here, is he just looking to get his photo taken?’. These are just things I tell myself,” he chuckled.
“I don’t really want to travel. The thought of the F1 calendar freaks me out, so that’s where I’m like, I don’t think there’s anything there that I would…

“I spoke to a few friends, in other sports, that are now retired athletes but went back into the sport as a manager, as a team owner, or taken a role. It’s funny. One of them in particular said, ‘It’s no easier than when I was competing’, because you still are so invested – especially in the athletes – that their problems are your problems, and you don’t get home from work. You’re still living with the weight of an athlete.

“I do love speaking with younger drivers and I do love trying to share some of my knowledge and experiences. I just don’t think I want to go through all those emotions again – it’s a lot. The thought of just being out of that and living a little more lightly, freely, that just feels nicer and better.
“I don’t think that would help me be maybe the best version of myself, especially around people that matter to me.”
The Perth native has been watching races on TV, with his father enjoying his insight. So might he enjoy being a pundit sometime? “The travel!” Ricciardo exclaimed.
Daniel Ricciardo, Grace Ricciardo, Joe Ricciardo

“It’s hard, because a lot of people tell me, ‘Oh, you’d be great on TV’. Look, there’s a part of me that, yes, it would be awesome to share many of my experiences and knowledge. Even if I watch a race with, even my dad, my dad is like, ‘Man, someone has to hear what you have to say during a race, because I learn so much from you when I watch a race’. Obviously that’s just because I was one of the 20. There’s, I guess, a few of us who have really experienced it to that level. Obviously I appreciate a lot of ex-drivers are in that space now, there’s a reason for that.

“There’s just also something refreshing about doing something completely different with life. Being able to live maybe two lives, in a way, the thought of that is also really quite nice. Maybe just closing that book and moving on, that also sounds cool. But then there’s times where I’m like, I have 35 years of racing wisdom and knowledge; to just kind of lock it in a box and never let it be seen or heard, is that a waste?
“I don’t know. I think that’s why I haven’t really jumped on anything, because I’m trying to make sure what I do is right.”
keyPointsZh: 里卡多表示，他不确定自己是否还想回到F1围场
keyPointsEn: Ricciardo said he is unsure whether he even wants to come back to the F1 paddock

items.originalTitle: IndyCar title sponsor NTT joins McLaren F1 team
items.summaryEn: IndyCar title sponsor NTT will join McLaren's Formula 1 team as an official partner in 2027, beginning a multi-year partnership centred on artificial intelligence.
detailZh: IndyCar冠名赞助商NTT将于2027年加入迈凯伦F1车队，成为其官方合作伙伴。
NTT今年结束对Arrow 迈凯伦 IndyCar车队的赞助后，与迈凯伦在F1达成多年度合作，但这两个品牌近年的渊源更深。
NTT与迈凯伦最早于2016年联手，当时现成为迈凯伦-本田F1车队的技术合作伙伴。
该合作由Just Marketing International协助促成，该公司由扎克·布朗在加入迈凯伦F1车队前领导，他现任迈凯伦赛车CEO。
因此，布朗在随后迈凯伦与NTT的合作项目中发挥了关键作用，包括2023年与NTT Data开启的印地赛车合作。
2023年底，迈凯伦F1赛车上甚至展示了少量NTT Data品牌标识；即便帕洛选择违约并留在奇普·加纳西车队，迈凯伦在印地赛车领域仍以修订后的条款保留了这一合作。
尽管印地赛车协议现已结束，但一项以人工智能为核心的全新合作将在F1启动。
迈凯伦在宣布新协议时表示，将“以人工智能安全治理为核心”，并称此举旨在随着技术发展“帮助监管使用人工智能带来的安全风险”。
布朗表示：“我们与NTT有着长期合作关系，很高兴欢迎他们成为迈凯伦万事达卡一级方程式车队的官方合作伙伴，在迄今已取得的成功基础上再接再厉。”
“人工智能在我们的赛事和业务中具有巨大潜力，NTT的专业能力将支持我们以负责任且安全的方式采用新技术。”
NTT将继续担任印地赛车（IndyCar）的冠名赞助商，同时扩大其在一级方程式赛场上的存在。
不过，它显然已将F1更大的影响力明确视为必要的优先事项。
NTT总裁兼首席执行官岛田明表示：“一级方程式赛车是一个全球舞台，世界上最聪明的人才汇聚于此，不断突破可能的极限。”
“迈凯伦车队通过投资于人才和技术取得了卓越的成绩，而NTT在应对社会挑战的同时不断自我变革，两者有许多共同之处。”
“自2019年以来，NTT通过冠名赞助NTT印地赛车系列赛，为赛车运动的发展做出了贡献。”
“这一新的合作伙伴关系建立在上述经验之上，我们将与迈凯伦车队一起，进一步加速NTT的全球业务。”
detailEn: IndyCar title sponsor NTT will join McLaren's Formula 1 team as an official partner in 2027.
The multi-year partnership with McLaren in F1 follows the culmination of NTT's sponsorship of the Arrow McLaren IndyCar team this year but the two brands have a deeper recent history.
NTT and McLaren first joined forces when what was then NTT Communications - now NTT Docomo - became a technology partner of McLaren-Honda in F1 in 2016.
That deal was assisted by Just Marketing International, the company spearheaded by Zak Brown prior to him joining McLaren's F1 team, which he now runs as McLaren Racing CEO.
Brown was therefore critical in subsequent McLaren/NTT ventures including an IndyCar partnership that began with NTT Data in 2023.

Light NTT Data branding was even displayed on McLaren's F1 cars at the end of 2023, and it stayed with McLaren in IndyCar on revised terms even when Palou opted to breach his contract and remain with Chip Ganassi Racing.
Though the IndyCar deal has now concluded, a fresh partnership will begin in F1 centred on artificial intelligence.
McLaren's announcement of the new deal puts "AI security governance at its core" - which it says is to "help regulate security risks from the use of AI" as the technology evolves.
Brown said: "We have a long-standing relationship with NTT and are excited to welcome them as an official partner of the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 team, to build on the success we've had to date.
"AI has enormous potential across our sport and our business, and NTT's expertise will support us in adopting new technologies in a responsible and secure way."
NTT will continue its title sponsorship of IndyCar alongside its expanded presence on the F1 grid.
It has clearly identified F1's bigger reach as a necessary priority though.
"Formula 1 is a global stage where the world's brightest minds come together to continually push the limits of what is possible," said Akira Shimada, NTT president and CEO.

"McLaren Racing, which has achieved outstanding results through its investment in people and technology, and NTT, which has continued to transform itself while addressing societal challenges, share much in common.
"Since 2019, NTT has contributed to the growth of motorsport through its title sponsorship of the NTT IndyCar series.
"This new partnerships builds on that experience, and together with McLaren Racing, we will further accelerate NTT's global business."
keyPointsZh: NTT与迈凯伦最早于2016年合作，当时现成为迈凯伦-本田F1车队的技术合作伙伴。
该合作由Just Marketing International协助促成，该公司由扎克·布朗在加入迈凯伦F1车队前领导，他现任迈凯伦赛车CEO。
迈凯伦表示新合作将把“人工智能安全治理”置于核心，以帮助监管AI使用带来的安全风险。

items.originalTitle: “We let him down” – Mercedes takes blame for George Russell’s Mexico GP heartbreak
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has admitted to "letting George Russell down" at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix, with Russell's bid for victory derailed within seconds by a technical issue.
detailZh: “我们让他失望了”——梅赛德斯为乔治·拉塞尔的墨西哥站心碎承担责任
又一次技术故障断送了拉塞尔的争胜希望，托托·沃尔夫已对此认账
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫承认在F1墨西哥大奖赛中“让乔治·拉塞尔失望”，这位英国车手的争胜希望在几秒内因技术故障破灭。
拉塞尔在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道从头排发车，与刘易斯·汉密尔顿并排，他的起步足以保住这一位置并跟住杆位车手的尾流，但他的银色赛车遇到了能量部署问题。
当他到达1号弯时，拉塞尔已经掉到第六位。几个弯之后，他试图攻击伊萨克·哈贾尔，但在进入6号弯时没有收手，撞上了红牛赛车导致其打转，因此被罚10秒。
结果，当瓦尔特利·博塔斯严重撞车引发红旗时，拉塞尔又回到了第六位，因为这次罚时让他落到了兰多·诺里斯后面，而他在比赛后半段也未能取得任何进展。
冲过终点线后，这位28岁的车手祝贺队友基米·安东内利夺得世界冠军，但没有多做停留；梅赛德斯为他免除了媒体职责，因此被国际汽联罚款5000欧元。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
沃尔夫说：“比赛结束后，我在国际汽联的称重区看到了乔治，显然他对当时的情况感到非常沮丧。他去看望基米，这展现了极大的体育精神。我认识乔治很久了，我知道对一名赛车手来说，这是一个灾难性的时刻。”
“也许今天的比赛在某种程度上是他整个赛季的缩影。这场比赛本是他该赢的。我们的赛车有速度，却在第一段直道上让他失望了。能量输出并不像我们预期的那样。”
“目前我非常支持他。我也曾经历过他这样非常难以应对的局面。他不做媒体工作或离开赛道是完全可以理解的。他要是留下来，反而会让我感到惊讶。这绝对值得尊重。”
这并不是拉塞尔第一次因能量输出不足而遇到麻烦；在斯帕-弗朗科尔尚赛道的肯梅尔直道上也发生过同样的情况，导致他与汉密尔顿相撞。这位英国车手在赛后退赛。
拉塞尔还受到了其他机械故障的困扰，尤其是动力单元故障，导致他在加拿大从领先位置退赛，在马来西亚从第三位退赛。
当被问及拉塞尔是否会在2027年“给他很大推动”时，安东内利承认：“毫无疑问，他在赛季某个阶段运气不好。说实话，他遇到的倒霉事比我多一点。我在银石和巴塞罗那也有过自己的时刻。而且，银石之后，我们不得不报废新的动力单元，因为里面有问题，我们不得不提前接受罚退，那是在蒙扎。”
“毫无疑问，我们都有过糟糕的时刻，但他肯定会回来的。你知道，他超级快。他这个赛季已经证明，当他状态在线时，很难被击败。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
“所以对我来说，关键就是专注于自己，不断努力提升标准，持续进步，持续发展，因为我认为到本赛季结束时，不只是乔治（拉塞尔）的问题，下个赛季也一样，红牛，尤其是马克斯（维斯塔潘），法拉利和迈凯伦，最终我们都会在那里竞争，这会是一场激烈的较量。所以，重要的是保持顶尖状态，不仅是对我的队友，也是对所有其他人。”
拉塞尔最终在周一晚上于Instagram发布了一条长消息，深入讲述了自己在周末事件之后的情绪。
“现在感觉是一个相当合适的时刻来发自内心地说几句。这个赛季的开局完全如我所愿，但很快就被糟糕的运气和糟糕的表现打乱了，”这位澳大利亚大奖赛冠军写道，他在接下来的18场大奖赛中只又赢了两场。
“这是我职业生涯中第一个真正意义上坏日子多于好日子的赛季。应对起来难吗？是的，非常难。每周都要重新振作起来难吗？是的，非常难。有时会感到困惑吗？经常。我只知道我已经倾尽全力，而2026年注定不属于我。”
“我想真诚地祝贺基米度过了一个绝对不可思议的赛季。你完全配得上这个总冠军。”
“感谢车队打造了本赛季最好的赛车和动力单元；看到大家在艰难的四年里齐心协力，让梅赛德斯重返巅峰，这令人备受鼓舞。”
“现在，我能承诺的是，在本赛季剩余时间以及进入下个赛季，我将竭尽全力，重新找回我职业生涯大部分时间所能展现的表现，并祈祷能找回一点运气。”
“感谢所有的支持。”
拉塞尔仍有机会锁定他车手锦标赛生涯最高排名，他在2022年和2025年都获得第四名。他目前再次以250分排名第四，分别落后维斯塔潘11分和汉密尔顿9分。
补充报道：罗伯托·钦切罗和罗纳德·沃丁
detailEn: “We let him down” – Mercedes takes blame for George Russell’s Mexico GP heartbreak
Yet another technical issue derailed Russell’s victory bid, and Toto Wolff has owned up to it
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has admitted to ‘letting George Russell down’ at Formula 1’s Mexico Grand Prix, with the Briton’s bid for victory derailed within seconds by a technical issue.

Russell was starting from the front row alongside Lewis Hamilton at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, and his initial getaway was good enough to retain that position and take the polesitter’s slipstream, but his Silver Arrow encountered an energy deployment issue.

By the time he got to Turn 1, Russell was down to sixth. A few corners later, he was attacking Isack Hadjar but failed to back out going into Turn 6 and tapped the Red Bull into a spin, landing a 10-second penalty.

As a consequence, Russell was sixth again by the time the red flag was waved for Valtteri Bottas’ hefty crash, as the penalty dropped him behind Lando Norris, and he failed to make any inroads during the second part of the race.

After the chequered flag, the 28-year-old congratulated team-mate Kimi Antonelli for his world title but did not stick around; Mercedes excused him from his media duties, landing a €5,000 fine from the FIA.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

“I saw George after the race on the FIA scales, and obviously he's distraught about the situation,” Wolff said. “It was a great show of sportsmanship to go and see Kimi. I have known George for such a long time and I know for a racing driver this is a catastrophic moment.

“Maybe today the race was a little bit a picture of his season. This was a race for him to win. We had the pace in the car and we let him down on the first straight. The energy delivery is not what we have thought it should be.

“I'm very much with him, at the moment. I've been in situations where he's very difficult to cope. Him not doing the media work or leaving the track is absolutely understandable. Him staying would have actually surprised me. That's absolutely honoured.”

This wasn’t the first time a lack of energy deployment caused trouble for Russell; it also happened at Spa-Francorchamps down the Kemmel Straight, leading to a collision with Hamilton. The Briton retired on the post.
Russell was also struck by other mechanical problems, notably power unit failures that caused retirements from the lead in Canada and third in Malaysia.

“Definitely he has had bad luck at some point in the season,” Antonelli admitted when asked if Russell would ‘give him a big push’ in 2027. “He has had a little bit more than me, being honest. I've also had my moments in Silverstone and Barcelona. Also, after Silverstone, we had to trash our new PU because it had a problem in it, and we had to take an earlier penalty, which was in Monza.
“Definitely, we've had our bad moments, but still, he will definitely come back. You know, he's super quick. He has shown this season that when he's on it, it's very hard to beat.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

“So it's just about, you know, on my side, keeping focused on myself, keep trying to raise the bar, keep improving, keep developing, because I think it's not going to be only a matter of George at the end of this season, but also for next season, Red Bull, especially with Max [Verstappen], Ferrari and McLaren, eventually, we're all going to be up there, and it's going to be a tight fight. So, it's going to be important to be on top of the game, not only against my team-mate but against all the others.”
Russell eventually posted a long message to Instagram on Monday evening, delving into his emotions following the weekend’s events.

“Now feels like a pretty suitable moment to speak from the heart. This season started off exactly how I had hoped but it very quickly unravelled with tough luck and poor performances,” wrote the Australian GP winner, who took only two more victories in the next 18 grands prix.

“It’s been the first proper season of my career where I’ve had more bad days than good. Has it been tough to deal with? Yes, very. Has it been tough to pick myself up week in, week out? Yes, very. Confusion at times? Often. All I know is that I’ve given it my all and 2026 was not meant to be my year.
“I want to sincerely congratulate Kimi on what has been an absolutely incredible season. You truly deserve the Championship.
“Thank you to the team for producing the best car and power unit this season; it’s been inspiring to see everyone coming together over four tough years to bring Mercedes back to the top.

“Now, all I can promise is that for the rest of this season, and into the next one, I will be giving my absolute all to rediscover the performance I have been capable of producing for the majority of my career and fingers crossed a little bit of luck returns.
“Thanks for all the support.”

Russell still has a chance to clinch his highest-ever finish in the drivers’ championship, having taken fourth place in 2022 and 2025. He currently lies fourth, again, with 250 points – 11 and nine points adrift of Verstappen and Hamilton respectively.
Additional reporting by Roberto Chinchero and Ronald Vording
